svg.title: V8 Generational GC: Semi-Space Scavenger and Orinoco Tri-Color Mark-Compact
svg.desc: Animated step-by-step visualization of V8 young-generation Cheney semi-space copying garbage collection with forwarding pointers, remembered-set write barriers, and promotion, paired with old-generation Orinoco Dijkstra tri-color concurrent marking, write-barrier greying, sweeping, and parallel compaction.
svg.text: V8 Generational GC: Semi-Space Scavenger & Orinoco Tri-Color Mark-Compact
Cheney BFS Copying (From -> To, Forwarding Pointers & Remembered Set) + Dijkstra Concurrent Tri-Color Marking

g.text: fwd -> A'
Obj B (garbage)
reclaimed on space swap
fwd -> C'
Obj A' (age=1)
A'.child -> C'
Obj C' (age=1)
leaf buffer
scan
free
Obj D promoted (no future copy)
Step 1 / 4
Scan Roots + Remembered Set (Old -> Young)
Write barrier recorded old_cache -> A; no full Old-Gen scan needed.
Initial queue: scan = free = to-space.start.
Invariant: every live root is evacuated exactly once.
Step 2 / 4
EVACUATE(A): Copy A -> To-Space, Leave Fwd Ptr
A copied to To-Space as A'; free advances; forwarding ptr saved in A.
Duplicate pointers to A (root_0 & remembered set) reuse fwd -> A'.
No mark stack needed: To-Space [scan, free) IS the BFS queue.
Step 3 / 4
BFS scan < free: Evacuate C & Promote D
Scanning A' discovers A'.child -> C; C copied to C', scan advances.
D already survived one scavenge -> PROMOTE(D) directly to Old Space.
Objects surviving 2 scavenges stop paying young-gen copy cost.
Step 4 / 4
scan == free: Swap Semi-Spaces (B Reclaimed)
swap(From, To). Unreachable Obj B is never visited — zero per-dead-obj cost.
Next allocations bump-allocate into the new empty From-Space.
Pause time scales strictly with surviving bytes, not garbage.

svg.text: Old-Space Object Graph + Dijkstra Write Barrier (No Black -> White)

g.text: Write Barrier: O1.x = O3
Marks O3 GREY immediately
O4 Swept · Compacted
Phase 1 / 4
Root Mark: O1 Enters Grey Worklist
Main thread briefly marks roots Grey; JS resumes immediately.
Background helper threads begin concurrent marking alongside JS.
Grey = discovered, children not yet scanned.
Phase 2 / 4
Concurrent Scan: O1 -> Black, O2 -> Grey
Helper pops O1, pushes child O2 as Grey, and paints O1 Black.
Main thread continues running request handlers without pausing.
Invariant: no Black object may point directly to a White object.
Phase 3 / 4
Mutator Race: Write Barrier Greys O3
JS executes O1.x = O3 (White). O1 is Black and won't be re-scanned!
Dijkstra marking barrier intercepts write and pushes O3 to Grey stack.
Prevents live O3 from being hidden and freed by the sweeper.
Phase 4 / 4
Concurrent Sweep & Parallel Compaction
Final atomic pause drains mark stack; O4 (White) is lazily swept.
Fragmented pages are evacuated in parallel during the pause.
Large in-heap caches increase live data and extend full-GC pauses.

svg.text: V8 Generational Hypothesis: Most Objects Die Young
